groups.C6: six objects in the sealed common cohort C6 list, both fixed M2 and fixed M4

optimization.seed_variation: Only the optimizer recipe seed changes. The original fixed-source initializer and its seed stay identical.

initialization.other_gates: all remaining original registered reprojection, parallax, coverage and independence gates
initialization.fallback: the original 1024 inverse-depth hypotheses per endpoint, total 2048
initialization.scale: physical separation of calibration centres s00 and s03 in world metres

source_sampling: round-robin in the declared logical slot order; M2 2500 updates per source and M4 1250 updates per source

calibration.selected_M4: s00=24, s01=lower selected ID, s02=higher selected ID, s03=22; use original native calibration for each camera and unchanged clip limits

development_selection.required_seal: both chosen IDs together with object, strategy, candidate pool and M2 checkpoint digest before either source image is opened for this observation
development_selection.selector_inputs: M2 checkpoint, the two endpoint source observations and permitted query/candidate poses only
development_selection.aperture: each branch opens only its two chosen photos and S0; other branches' photos and all evaluation poses are unavailable to the selector

alias: same object, official IDs in identical logical slot order, exact per-slot source RGB/camera bytes, initialization method and numerical inputs, optimizer seed and recipe, runtime and selected endpoint. Record a separate observation and selection receipt for every strategy.
failure: record terminal failures and aliases under their original logical cells. Never add candidate strategies or select a different checkpoint in response to target errors.
